item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 31/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The ridge of high pressure over southeastern China will bring a strong easterly airstream to the coast of southern China today. A broad trough of low pressure over the northern part of the South China Sea will bring unsettled weather to the region today and in the next couple of days. The area of low pressure to the east of Hainan Island will move eastwards across the northern part of the South China Sea. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, the weather will be hot with a few showers over the coast of southern China early next week. Another trough of low pressure over central China is expected to edge closer to southern China on Tuesday and Wednesday. The weather will become unsettled over the region.
